assoccfwnum1.title: Associated Condition for Work 1
assoccfwnum1.remarks: Identifies another condition for work (for example, isolated or depressurized) associated with this condition for work.

assoccfwnum2.title: Associated Condition for Work 2
assoccfwnum2.remarks: Identifies another condition for work (for example, isolated or depressurized) associated with this condition for work.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of the condition for work.

functn.title: Function
functn.remarks: The condition for work function (for example, drilling, production, projects, or inspection).

type.title: Type
type.remarks: Identifies the condition for work type to distinguish among plant operation modes (for example, shutdown or operational).

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date and time when the condition for work was created or was changed through the Change Status action.

cfwnum.title: Condition for Work
cfwnum.remarks: The identifier of the condition for work.

usewithpermit.title: Use with Permit to Work
usewithpermit.remarks: Specifies whether to associate a permit to work record with this condition for work record.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the condition for work.
